collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_d2d_ref --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qkvd_kv_end --macro-view physical/qwen_die_masters/views/ot_qkvd_sbuf --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkd_fbuf8_ref/views/ot_qkvd_fbuf8 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
